name: HextaUI Component

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 HextaUI 提供基于 shadcn/ui 与 Base UI 的 React 组件、Hooks 和工具，可通过 shadcn CLI 将源码复制进项目；组件页按表单、浮层、数据展示、布局、反馈、聊天 UI 等分类浏览，并附实时状态文档。另有 Pro 区块，如 Chat Thread、Prompt Input、Voice Mode、Agent Todos，提供流式、工具调用与语音等 AI 聊天界面。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by HextaUI (https://hextaui.com/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, base-ui, shadcn-ui.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
